'''Pyrewood Sentries''' are [[warrior]]s located in [[Pyrewood Village]] in [[Silverpine Forest]] during the day, appearing as [[human]]s. At night, they transform into their [[worgen]] form as '''[[Moonrage Sentry|Moonrage Sentries]]'''.

==Abilities==
* '''Battle Roar''' — Increases the Physical damage dealt by nearby party members for 1 min.
* '''Defensive Stance''' — Assumes a defensive stance. Lasts 3 min.
* '''Demoralizing Shout''' — Reduces the melee attack power of nearby enemies for 30 sec.
* '''Shield Bash''' — Bashes an enemy with the caster's shield, inflicting Physical damage and interrupting the spell being cast.
* '''Shield Block''' — Increases the caster's chance to block by 75% for 5 sec., but will only block 1 attack.

==Objective of==
* Drop [[Pyrewood Shackle]] for {{questlong|Horde|15+|Arugal's Folly (4)|Arugal's Folly}}.

==Notes==
* They are affiliated with [[Stormwind (faction)|Stormwind]] during daytime to make them unattackable by Alliance players.
